description: This Java class 'DefaultTbAssetService' provides service methods for managing assets in the Thingsboard platform, including saving, deleting, assigning, and unassigning assets to customers and edges.

classes.name: DefaultTbAssetService
classes.description: Service class for managing assets, extending AbstractTbEntityService and implementing TbAssetService.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an asset with default name conflict strategy.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an asset with specified name conflict strategy.

methods.name: assignAssetToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns an asset to a customer.

methods.name: unassignAssetToCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns an asset from a customer.

methods.name: assignAssetToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Assigns an asset to the public customer.

methods.name: assignAssetToEdge
methods.description: Assigns an asset to an edge.

methods.name: unassignAssetFromEdge
methods.description: Unassigns an asset from an edge.
